subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until maintainers resolve both the isolated cron base-session retention behavior and the cron cadence guardrail policy?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent contract spans compatibility-sensitive session preservation and operator-facing cadence policy already split across multiple open PRs.

options.title: Keep umbrella open for coordinated decision
options.body: Track #90194 or an equivalent orphan-cleanup fix plus the cadence warning/minInterval decision before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow to retention only
options.body: Close or split cadence guardrails separately and use this issue only for the isolated cron base-session retention bug.

options.title: Defer core guardrails
options.body: Leave base-session preservation as-is and document operational limits instead, accepting continued accumulation risk for affected cron setups.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open for coordinated decision
